review_candidates.title: Senior Gas Turbine SCR Design Engineer
review_candidates.description: Gen-Systems Power Solutions is seeking a Senior Gas Turbine SCR Design Engineer to support our dedicated SCR Engineering and Emissions Control organization in Houston. This position will serve as a senior technical resource for the design, application, integration, and execution of Selective Catalytic Reduction (SCR) systems used in gas turbine, HRSG, combined-cycle, simple-cycle, and industrial power-generation applications . The ideal candidate will have direct responsibility for SCR systems beyond simulation alone, including experience with catalyst/reactor systems, ammonia injection, NOx reduction, exhaust-system integration, equipment design, fabrication, commissioning, startup, or field support . Key Responsibilities Design and review SCR systems for gas turbine, HRSG, combined-cycle, simple-cycle, and industrial power applications. Develop and evaluate SCR reactor, catalyst, ammonia injection, and exhaust-system configurations. Review customer operating conditions, emissions requirements, exhaust flow, temperature, pressure drop, catalyst arrangement, and equipment interfaces. Support ammonia injection grid (AIG), ammonia flow control, reagent distribution, and related SCR ancillary systems. Develop and review equipment layouts, general arrangements, specifications, fabrication drawings, and technical documentation. Coordinate SCR integration with gas turbine exhaust systems, HRSGs, ducting, dampers, expansion joints, stacks, support steel, controls, and related balance-of-plant equipment. Support catalyst selection, sizing, replacement, accessibility, and performance considerations. Review customer specifications, RFQs, technical requirements, and operating data. Support technical proposals, equipment scope, clarifications, cost inputs, and project handoff. Coordinate with catalyst suppliers, fabricators, procurement, engineering teams, project management, and customers. Support equipment through fabrication, installation, commissioning, startup, troubleshooting, and field modifications. Participate in technical reviews with Gen-Systems engineering teams and headquarters engineering resources in Yantai, China. Develop and improve SCR engineering standards, design practices, and lessons learned. Required Qualifications 10+ years of engineering experience involving SCR systems, emissions-control equipment, catalyst systems, gas turbine exhaust systems, HRSGs, or related power-generation equipment . Direct experience with SCR systems used in gas turbine, HRSG, combined-cycle, simple-cycle, or comparable industrial power applications. Experience with SCR reactor systems, catalyst systems, ammonia injection, AIG, NOx reduction, or related emissions-control equipment . Experience translating customer operating and emissions requirements into engineered equipment solutions. Working knowledge of gas turbine exhaust conditions and their impact on SCR performance. Experience supporting engineered equipment through design and at least one later phase such as fabrication, construction, commissioning, startup, or field troubleshooting. Ability to review technical drawings, specifications, equipment layouts, and supplier documentation. Experience coordinating with engineering, suppliers, fabrication, procurement, project teams, and customers. Ability to work on-site in Houston and travel to suppliers, customer sites, and project locations as required. Preferred Qualifications 15+ years of directly relevant SCR, power-generation, gas turbine, HRSG, or emissions-control experience. Direct experience with combined-cycle or simple-cycle SCR systems . Experience with catalyst sizing, catalyst replacement, reactor design, AIG/AFCU systems, or ammonia distribution. Experience with CEMS, emissions performance testing, or SCR commissioning. Experience with CFD, cold-flow modeling, or flow-distribution analysis as part of broader SCR system engineering. Experience with gas turbine exhaust-system manufacturers, SCR equipment suppliers, catalyst companies, power-generation OEMs, or EPC organizations. Experience with companies such as BRADEN, Innova Global, Callidus Technologies, Mitsubishi Power, GE Vernova, Siemens Energy, Baker Hughes, John Zink Hamworthy Combustion, Fluor, Technip Energies, Jacobs, or comparable organizations. Mandarin Chinese language capability is a strong plus due to regular technical coordination with engineering teams in Yantai, China. Houston-area candidates are strongly preferred.
